title: PROJECTOR
rule: one frame per log: the frame never moves, the log scrolls beside it and decides what the frame shows
description: Client work as a numbered log beside one pinned frame, with the own projects in the middle of the page. Rows 01-04: Bayyinah TV (the public home page beside its App Store frame, the ring on the three places a member subscribes: bayyinahtv.com, App Store, Google Play), the billing report (16 requests and a timeout, now 2; the Now lane shrinks from 16 cells to 2 when the row becomes current), the care platform, and Viva Fresh (the line 'built once for [iPhone] and [Android]' holds two pills; a press wipes the frame from the App Store screen to the Google Play screen). Rows 05-07 'Own projects': Offday (four light tabs; Best dates is the modal alone, on the app's own backdrop tone), OFFBEAT (the 8-step drum machine at 1.12 of its CSS size) and FORM (the trefoil with its formula, ring on the formula). Rows 08-11 'More client work' in a second log with its own pinned frame: Design System v2, Incentiv, Read to Feed, Dukagjini Bookstore.
signature: Big Shoulders Display for the row numerals, the report diagram and the store panel; Public Sans for text; ink #141B06 on a chartreuse field #D9F26B (14.2:1; muted #3E4A14 at 7.7:1). Both faces are preloaded by the page; text never waits for them. Identity: 'Gentrit Rashiti builds web and mobile apps that people subscribe to, shop in and read with.' then '5+ years. Part of two platform rewrites. Based in Kosovo, working remotely.' Desktop: a 440 px log at the left with the identity line at its top; an 880 x 676 frame at the right, sticky, with one caption line under it, set in the middle of the viewport. Rows: 01 Bayyinah TV pricing page (ring on Start 7-Day Free Trial; phone crop rings 'Watch anytime, anywhere, on mobile, tablet or desktop'); 02 the 16 -> 2 report diagram; 03 the real care team dashboard with invented data (ring on the organization name in the top bar; phone crop rings the 24 patients ring); 04 Viva Fresh, 07 Read to Feed (public store screen, ring on the book card with 'Read 36%', archived store links) and 08 Dukagjini Bookstore as iPhone screens at source pixels with a store panel; 05 Design System v2 as its real Storybook screen of buttons and alerts at no more than its CSS size on white (ring on the buttons); 06 Incentiv sign-in. Current row has three signals: the plate, the result band and the hairline with its ring (no numeral fill, no tray, no second index on phone). Motion: the first screenshot fades in 200 ms, then the hairline draws in 180 ms to its ring. A row becomes current after it settles at 42% of the viewport for 160 ms; the plate cross-fades in 200 ms, the result band wipes in (clip-path, 240 ms), the old line fades (120 ms) and the new one draws (180 ms). Keyboard moves (arrows, Home, End) jump with no animation. Phone: the frame pins at the top at 4:3; crops grow inside their own screen bounds and are never shown above source pixels; the ring alone marks the proof. Reduced motion: no fade, no wipe, no draw. Own projects: rows 09-11 use the log's grid (440 | 880), numerals, role line and band; each plate is a 1 px ink frame with the ring on the proving part. Offday plates are 2x captures shown at 880 px (no upscale); OFFBEAT and FORM show their whole home screen at 0.61. A row turns current once when half its plate is on screen: band wipe 240 ms, then the line draws 180 ms and the ring fades in 120 ms. Offday tabs: pointer = 200 ms cross-fade + new band wipe + line redraw; arrow keys = instant. Phone: ring only, phone captures for best dates, OFFBEAT and FORM. Report diagram: the 14 requests that are gone keep a dashed place in the Now lane.
holdback: Lowest: original, 7/10. A sticky frame beside a numbered log is a known scrollytelling layout; the page now has two logs and an own-projects band between them, which adds a second pinned frame but no new idea. Other limits: the Bayyinah TV web crop is a 1x capture (2x on a 2x screen; no 2x capture exists); the Android Viva Fresh screen is shown at 0.91 and the iPhone screen at 0.78 so the two line up row for row; on phone the OFFBEAT plate is a thin band (the whole 8-step grid, no labels, so no text is under 11 px); the store frames for rows 04, 10, 11 are @3x captures; Offday still has no public link; the footer names the school as 'UBT', as the CV does.
